items.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 20 at 9:12AM AKDT until October 20 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:

* WHEN...For the High Wind Warning, until 10 PM AKDT this evening.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 20 at 3:55AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
Light to moderate snow will continue through late this morning
before tapering off to scattered snow showers this afternoon. Up
to three inches of additional snow accumulation is possible with
the highest amounts likely at the top of Turnagain Pass.
Visibility may be reduced to less than one mile in any heavier
snow.

Be prepared for slippery roads. Slow down and use caution while
traveling. For the latest road conditions call 5 1 1 or visit
511.alaska.gov.
items.areas: East Turnagain Arm; Portage; Interior Kenai Peninsula; Turnagain Pass

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 20 at 3:18AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
A strong storm system is moving into the northern half of the Alaska
Panhandle and the northeast Gulf Coast this morning and will
continue through today. Total rain accumulation are expected to be
between 1.5-3.5 inches, with the heaviest rain late Tuesday morning
into Tuesday afternoon. Wet snow is possibly on the Klondike Highway
near White Pass up to 3 inches through tonight, though warm surface
temperatures may hinder these snow totals.
items.areas: Municipality of Skagway; Haines Borough and Klukwan
